general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: A public purpose does not make the property free.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Just compensation is explained and applied to a public-road taking.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Still, contract rights are subject to valid government regulation for public welfare.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Contract duties and the public-welfare limitation are taught with an application.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: A **quasi-judicial body** is a government body outside the courts that hears facts and decides certain disputes.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Both court and quasi-judicial access receive separate poverty-denial examples.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Allowing a person to file a case does not by itself settle whether needed legal help has been provided.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Adequate assistance is distinguished from access and tested separately.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: These custodial rights may be waived only in writing and in the presence of counsel.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Information, silence, waiver requirements, coercion prohibitions and statement exclusion are all taught.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: If the person cannot afford a lawyer, one must be provided.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Competent independent counsel is defined; information, provided counsel and counseled waiver safeguards are explained.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Section $13$ protects bail before conviction, subject to its stated exception.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Both exception conditions, recognizance, excessive bail and suspension protection are supplied.

lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.quote: Each has conditions, so a short description alone cannot decide every real case.
lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.note: The optional caution about the catalogue limits is explicit.
